ns2:course.label: International Collaborations for Global impact
ns2:course.description: An experiential course designed to provide domestic and international students with real-world practice in problem-solving, cross-cultural communication, and organizational support. Applying a Human-Centered Design framework, students are trained to develop innovative solutions to social challenges that impact our world by collaborating with international organizations and partners. May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 6 hours. Enrollment in LAS 205 for both the Fall and consecutive Spring term is a requirement for active participation in the LAS Global Leaders Program. Prerequisite: Restricted to LAS second-year students who have completed LAS 195 and are accepted into the Global Leaders Program.
